description: Next-Generation AI Video Creation HappyHorse is a professional-grade AI video generation platform powered by the industry-leading HappyHorse-1.0 model. Developed by Alibaba-ATH, this tool is designed to empower creators by providing studio-grade cinematic motion and high-fidelity 1080p resolution for every project. Cinematic Features and Consistency The platform specializes in maintaining multi-shot consistency across entire stories, allowing users to render full short films from a single prompt
